			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_proposal_rejected
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_proposal_locked days = 120 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_patron_cooldown days = 365 } }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOV_ai_proposal_cooldown days = 730 } }
			SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.20 days = 1 } }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_proposal_sent_tt
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
		}
	}

	COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_intelligence_operation
		cost = 50
		days_re_enable = 180
		fire_only_once = no
		target_root_trigger = { always = yes }
		targets = { UKR BLR EST LAT LIT ARM AZE GEO KAZ KYR TAJ TRK UZB MLV }
		target_non_existing = no
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			}
		}
		available = {
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_slanderer }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat_free_trig_tt
				NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat_pending }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat"
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat_pending
			set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_accuser_id = ROOT.id }
			set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_accused_id = FROM.id }
			every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_accused } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_accused }
			FROM = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_accused }
			SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.17 days = 1 } }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_kompromat_sent_tt
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
		}
	}

	COLDWAR_SOV_declare_sovereignty = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_independence
		cost = 75
		fire_only_once = yes
		visible = {
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_declaration_of_sovereignty }
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_no_seat_trig_tt
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat }
			}
			OR = {
				date > 1985.1.1
				SOV = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion < 55 } }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_SOV_declare_sovereignty"
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_declaration_of_sovereignty
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -8 }
			COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes
			SOV = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_union_modifier } } } hidden_effect = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_union_modifier } } }
				custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_SOV_union_modifier }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_union_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = -0.01 tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_mod_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier_tt }
				hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 1 SOV = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_union_cohesion < 15 } } }
		}
	}
